import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(3)]
    b = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(3)]

    max_val = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0])
    min_val = max(0, a[0] + b[1] - n) + max(0, a[1] + b[2] - n) + max(0, a[2] + b[0] - n)

    sys.stdout.write(f"{min_val} {max_val}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
